name: agent-clock
description: Injects the real current date and time into the agent's context on every prompt and at session start, so it never reasons from a stale session timestamp.

interface.shortDescription: Keeps your coding agent aware of the real current date and time.
interface.longDescription: Injects a fresh real-world timestamp into the agent's context on every user prompt and at session start, so it never answers from a clock frozen when the session began.
